scope: Primary structural and metric sources. The adjugate bound, uniform CM displacement estimate and specialization to 513*H_CM_disk+8400 are project deductions.

sources.title: The Stacks Project, The relative dualizing sheaf
sources.use: Relative duality and invertibility/base change of the dualizing sheaf on the nodal stable model. The integral nodal differential and Gaussian map are proved locally in the D103 report.
sources.does_not_supply: The stable coarse-canonical fibre height or its comparison with a quaternionic Hodge model.

sources.title: Ariyan Javanpeykar, Polynomial bounds for Arakelov invariants of Belyi curves; appendix by Peter Bruin
locations: Section 2.1, pages 93-94: L2 and determinant metrics
Sections 2.2-2.3, pages 97-98: arithmetic degree and stable Faltings height
sources.use: Matching metric normalization and the universal lower bound h_Fal(C)>=-g*log(2*pi).
sources.does_not_supply: An upper bound for H_CM_disk. No Belyi map or Belyi-degree upper bound is assumed or used.

sources.title: Roy Zhao, Heights of Special Points on Quaternionic Shimura Varieties
locations: Section 6: arithmetic Hodge bundles and metrics
sources.use: Potential next input for an arithmetic Hodge height; its finite ramification condition allows the common dyadic ramification here.
sources.does_not_supply: A proved integral comparison with the stable coarse-canonical fibre of our genus-16 normalizer quotient. No numerical H_CM_disk bound is claimed.
